items.question: Trong câu "A stakeholder is anyone affected by the project, anyone who can affect it, or anyone with an interest in its outcome.", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stakeholder is anyone affected by the project, anyone who can affect it, or anyone with an interest in its outcome.", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng đến. "Affect" là động từ; danh từ tương ứng là "effect" (tác động) — hai từ hay bị nhầm.
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an impact on. "Affect" is the verb; the related noun is "effect" — a common mix-up.

items.question: Trong câu "A stakeholder is anyone affected by the project, anyone who can affect it, or anyone with an interest in its outcome.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stakeholder is anyone affected by the project, anyone who can affect it, or anyone with an interest in its outcome.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "The outcome of a project" = kết quả cuối cùng; "report back the outcome" = báo lại kết quả.
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (noun): the end result. "The outcome of a project" is how it ends up; "report back the outcome" means tell people the result.

items.question: Trong câu "That definition is far broader than newcomers assume.", từ "broad" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That definition is far broader than newcomers assume.", what does "broad" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: broad /brɔːd/ (tính từ): rộng, bao quát. "Far broader than" = rộng hơn nhiều so với; danh từ "breadth", động từ "broaden".
items.explanationEn: broad /brɔːd/ (adjective): wide in scope. "Far broader than" means much wider than; noun "breadth", verb "broaden".

items.question: Trong câu "They bear the consequences yet never open the software", từ "bear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They bear the consequences yet never open the software", what does "bear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bear /ber/ (động từ): gánh chịu. "Bear the consequences/cost" = gánh chịu hậu quả/chi phí; "can't bear it" = không chịu nổi.
items.explanationEn: bear /ber/ (verb): to suffer or carry. "Bear the consequences/cost" means carry them; "I can't bear it" means I cannot tolerate it.

items.question: Trong câu "They bear the consequences yet never open the software", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They bear the consequences yet never open the software", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɑːnsəkwens/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "Bear/face the consequences" = chịu hậu quả; "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɑːnsəkwens/ (noun): a result. "Bear/face the consequences" is common; "as a consequence" means as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "They live with the product daily after handover", từ "handover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They live with the product daily after handover", what does "handover" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handover /ˈhændoʊvər/ (danh từ): việc bàn giao. Cụm động từ "hand over" = bàn giao; sau handover đội vận hành sống cùng sản phẩm hằng ngày.
items.explanationEn: handover /ˈhændoʊvər/ (noun): passing on control. The phrasal verb is "hand over"; after handover, operations live with the product daily.

items.question: Trong câu "They hold a late veto if they are not consulted early", từ "veto" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They hold a late veto if they are not consulted early", what does "veto" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: veto /ˈviːtoʊ/ (danh từ): quyền phủ quyết. "Hold/use a veto" = có/dùng quyền phủ quyết; động từ "veto a decision".
items.explanationEn: veto /ˈviːtoʊ/ (noun): the power to block. "Hold/use a veto" means having the power to block; also a verb, "veto a decision".

items.question: Trong câu "They hold a late veto if they are not consulted early", từ "consult" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They hold a late veto if they are not consulted early", what does "consult" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look up in a book
items.explanation: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (động từ): hỏi ý kiến. "Consult someone" = hỏi ý kiến ai; "consult a dictionary" = tra từ điển; "consultant" = cố vấn.
items.explanationEn: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (verb): to ask for advice. "Consult someone" means asking their view; "consult a dictionary" means look something up; a "consultant" is an adviser.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic lesson: Legal appears in the final week before release and says the feature breaches a regulation.", từ "breach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic lesson: Legal appears in the final week before release and says the feature breaches a regulation.", what does "breach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: breach /briːtʃ/ (động từ): vi phạm. "Breach a regulation/contract" = vi phạm quy định/hợp đồng; "data breach" = rò rỉ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (verb): to break a rule. "Breach a regulation/contract" means break it; a "data breach" is a security leak.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic lesson: Legal appears in the final week before release and says the feature breaches a regulation.", từ "regulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic lesson: Legal appears in the final week before release and says the feature breaches a regulation.", what does "regulation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: regulation /ˌreɡjuˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): quy định pháp lý. Động từ "regulate"; ví dụ quy định bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân là một regulation.
items.explanationEn: regulation /ˌreɡjuˈleɪʃn/ (noun): an official rule. Verb: "regulate"; data-protection law is a typical regulation.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of that late discovery usually dwarfs the cost of inviting them to one meeting in week one.", từ "dwarf" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of that late discovery usually dwarfs the cost of inviting them to one meeting in week one.", what does "dwarf" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dwarf /dwɔːrf/ (động từ): làm lu mờ. "X dwarfs Y" = X lớn đến mức Y trông nhỏ xíu; danh từ "dwarf" = người lùn.
items.explanationEn: dwarf /dwɔːrf/ (verb): to make seem tiny. "X dwarfs Y" means X is so large that Y looks tiny; the noun "dwarf" is a very small person.

items.question: Trong câu "Hunt for them deliberately.", từ "hunt for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hunt for them deliberately.", what does "hunt for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): truy tìm. "Hunt for" = lùng tìm; "job hunting" = đi tìm việc.
items.explanationEn: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to search hard for. "Hunt for" means search actively; "job hunting" is looking for work.

items.question: Trong câu "Hunt for them deliberately.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hunt for them deliberately.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (trạng từ): một cách có chủ đích. Trái nghĩa "accidentally"; "deliberately search" = chủ động tìm, không chờ họ tự xuất hiện.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose. Opposite of "accidentally"; searching deliberately means not waiting for people to turn up.

items.question: Trong câu "Technique 1 — Follow the flow. Chart the end-to-end business process and ask at each step:", từ "end-to-end" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technique 1 — Follow the flow. Chart the end-to-end business process and ask at each step:", what does "end-to-end" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: end-to-end /ˌend tə ˈend/ (tính từ): từ đầu đến cuối. "End-to-end process" = quy trình trọn vẹn; cũng gặp "end-to-end testing" (kiểm thử toàn luồng).
items.explanationEn: end-to-end /ˌend tə ˈend/ (adjective): from start to finish. An "end-to-end process" covers the whole flow; compare "end-to-end testing".

items.question: Trong câu "Every handoff is a potential stakeholder.", từ "handoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every handoff is a potential stakeholder.", what does "handoff" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handoff /ˈhændɔːf/ (danh từ): điểm chuyển giao. "Handoff" = chỗ công việc được chuyển từ người/bộ phận này sang người khác; gần nghĩa "handover".
items.explanationEn: handoff /ˈhændɔːf/ (noun): a passing of work. A "handoff" is where work passes from one person or team to another; close to "handover".

items.question: Trong câu "Every handoff is a potential stakeholder.", từ "potential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every handoff is a potential stakeholder.", what does "potential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: potential /pəˈtenʃl/ (tính từ): có thể là. "Potential stakeholder/customer" = người có thể là stakeholder/khách hàng; danh từ "potential" = tiềm năng.
items.explanationEn: potential /pəˈtenʃl/ (adjective): possible. A "potential stakeholder/customer" is a possible one; the noun "potential" means capacity to develop.

items.question: Trong câu "who is accountable for its quality?", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "who is accountable for its quality?", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm. "Be accountable for" = chịu trách nhiệm giải trình về; danh từ "accountability".
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (adjective): responsible. "Be accountable for" means answerable for it; noun: "accountability".

items.question: Trong câu "Technique 4 — Review an ecosystem map.", từ "ecosystem" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technique 4 — Review an ecosystem map.", what does "ecosystem" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ecosystem /ˈiːkoʊsɪstəm/ (danh từ): hệ sinh thái (hệ thống). Nghĩa gốc là hệ sinh thái tự nhiên; trong IT là mạng lưới các hệ thống kết nối với nhau.
items.explanationEn: ecosystem /ˈiːkoʊsɪstəm/ (noun): a web of linked systems. Originally a natural habitat; in IT it is the network of connected systems.

items.question: Trong câu "Diagram every system your application exchanges data with.", từ "exchange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Diagram every system your application exchanges data with.", what does "exchange" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (động từ): trao đổi. "Exchange data with" = trao đổi dữ liệu với; "exchange rate" = tỷ giá.
items.explanationEn: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (verb): to send and receive. "Exchange data with" means send and receive it; an "exchange rate" is a currency price.

items.question: Trong câu "Technique 5 — Ask who will object.", từ "object" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technique 5 — Ask who will object.", what does "object" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: object /əbˈdʒekt/ (động từ): phản đối. Động từ /əbˈdʒekt/ = phản đối; danh từ "object" /ˈɑːbdʒekt/ = đồ vật, đối tượng. "Objection" = sự phản đối.
items.explanationEn: object /əbˈdʒekt/ (verb): to oppose. The verb /əbˈdʒekt/ means to oppose; the noun /ˈɑːbdʒekt/ is a thing. Noun of the verb: "objection".

items.question: Trong câu "This finds influential people you need to win over early.", từ "influential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This finds influential people you need to win over early.", what does "influential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: influential /ˌɪnfluˈenʃl/ (tính từ): có ảnh hưởng lớn. Gốc "influence"; "influential people" = người có tầm ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: influential /ˌɪnfluˈenʃl/ (adjective): having strong sway. From "influence"; "influential people" can shape decisions.

items.question: Trong câu "This finds influential people you need to win over early.", từ "win over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This finds influential people you need to win over early.", what does "win over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: win over /wɪn ˈoʊvər/ (cụm từ): thuyết phục. "Win someone over" = thuyết phục ai về phe mình.
items.explanationEn: win over /wɪn ˈoʊvər/ (phrase): to persuade. "Win someone over" means persuading them to support you.

items.question: Trong câu "The influence-interest matrix allocates communication effort.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The influence-interest matrix allocates communication effort.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ. "Allocate time/resources" = phân bổ thời gian/nguồn lực; danh từ "allocation".
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to distribute. "Allocate time/resources" means share them out; noun: "allocation".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", từ "periodic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", what does "periodic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: periodic /ˌpɪriˈɑːdɪk/ (tính từ): định kỳ. "Periodic summaries/reports" = tóm tắt/báo cáo định kỳ; trạng từ "periodically".
items.explanationEn: periodic /ˌpɪriˈɑːdɪk/ (adjective): recurring. "Periodic summaries/reports" come at regular intervals; adverb: "periodically".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", từ "burden" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", what does "burden" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: burden /ˈbɜːrdn/ (động từ): đè nặng. "Burden someone with something" = bắt ai gánh thứ gì; danh từ "burden" = gánh nặng.
items.explanationEn: burden /ˈbɜːrdn/ (verb): to load down. "Burden someone with something" means load them with it; the noun means a heavy load.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", từ "operational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep satisfied — periodic summaries, do not burden them with operational detail", what does "operational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: operational /ˌɑːpəˈreɪʃənl/ (tính từ): thuộc vận hành. "Operational detail" = chi tiết vận hành; nghĩa khác "fully operational" = đang hoạt động được.
items.explanationEn: operational /ˌɑːpəˈreɪʃənl/ (adjective): about daily running. "Operational detail" concerns day-to-day running; "fully operational" means working.

items.question: Trong câu "Monitor — notify on major changes", từ "notify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Monitor — notify on major changes", what does "notify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notify /ˈnoʊtɪfaɪ/ (động từ): thông báo. "Notify someone of/on something" = báo cho ai; danh từ "notification".
items.explanationEn: notify /ˈnoʊtɪfaɪ/ (verb): to inform. "Notify someone of something" means inform them; noun: "notification".

items.question: Trong câu "These are usually the product champions and decision-makers.", từ "champion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are usually the product champions and decision-makers.", what does "champion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: champion /ˈtʃæmpiən/ (danh từ): người đại diện ủng hộ. "Product champion" = người dùng đại diện và bênh vực sản phẩm; nghĩa thường gặp là nhà vô địch.
items.explanationEn: champion /ˈtʃæmpiən/ (noun): a user advocate. A "product champion" represents users and backs the product; the common sense is a contest winner.

items.question: Trong câu "A person's position can shift during the project.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A person's position can shift during the project.", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển. "Shift" = dịch chuyển; danh từ "shift" = ca làm việc, cũng là phím Shift.
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to change or move. "Shift" means move or change; the noun is a work period, and also a keyboard key.

items.question: Trong câu "A director who started disengaged becomes very interested once the budget overruns.", từ "disengaged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A director who started disengaged becomes very interested once the budget overruns.", what does "disengaged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disengaged /ˌdɪsɪnˈɡeɪdʒd/ (tính từ): thờ ơ. Trái nghĩa "engaged" (gắn bó, quan tâm); "stakeholder engagement" = sự tham gia của stakeholder.
items.explanationEn: disengaged /ˌdɪsɪnˈɡeɪdʒd/ (adjective): uninvolved. Opposite of "engaged"; "stakeholder engagement" is how involved stakeholders are.

items.question: Trong câu "A director who started disengaged becomes very interested once the budget overruns.", từ "overrun" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A director who started disengaged becomes very interested once the budget overruns.", what does "overrun" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overrun /ˌoʊvərˈrʌn/ (động từ): vượt ngân sách. "Budget overrun" = vượt ngân sách; "overrun" còn là tràn ngập (a garden overrun with weeds).
items.explanationEn: overrun /ˌoʊvərˈrʌn/ (verb): to go over a limit. A "budget overrun" goes over the planned amount; "overrun" also means swarm over (a garden overrun with weeds).

items.question: Trong câu "An important caution: do not confuse job title with influence.", từ "caution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important caution: do not confuse job title with influence.", what does "caution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: caution /ˈkɔːʃn/ (danh từ): lời cảnh báo. "A word of caution" = lời cảnh báo; tính từ "cautious" = thận trọng.
items.explanationEn: caution /ˈkɔːʃn/ (noun): a warning. "A word of caution" is a warning; adjective: "cautious".

items.question: Trong câu "A long-serving operations specialist whom everyone consults may hold more real influence than a newly appointed department head.", từ "long-serving" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A long-serving operations specialist whom everyone consults may hold more real influence than a newly appointed department head.", what does "long-serving" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: long-serving /ˌlɔːŋ ˈsɜːrvɪŋ/ (tính từ): làm việc lâu năm. "Long-serving employee" = nhân viên thâm niên; thường có ảnh hưởng thật lớn hơn chức danh.
items.explanationEn: long-serving /ˌlɔːŋ ˈsɜːrvɪŋ/ (adjective): in the job for years. A "long-serving employee" has been there for years and often has real influence.

items.question: Trong câu "A long-serving operations specialist whom everyone consults may hold more real influence than a newly appointed department head.", từ "appoint" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A long-serving operations specialist whom everyone consults may hold more real influence than a newly appointed department head.", what does "appoint" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: appoint /əˈpɔɪnt/ (động từ): bổ nhiệm. "Newly appointed" = mới được bổ nhiệm; danh từ "appointment" còn nghĩa là cuộc hẹn.
items.explanationEn: appoint /əˈpɔɪnt/ (verb): to name to a post. "Newly appointed" means recently given the role; the noun "appointment" can also mean a scheduled meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "For each important user class, find a product champion: a real, experienced user whom colleagues trust and who is willing to spend time on the project.", từ "willing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each important user class, find a product champion: a real, experienced user whom colleagues trust and who is willing to spend time on the project.", what does "willing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: willing /ˈwɪlɪŋ/ (tính từ): sẵn lòng. "Be willing to do something" = sẵn lòng làm; trái nghĩa "unwilling".
items.explanationEn: willing /ˈwɪlɪŋ/ (adjective): happy to. "Be willing to do something" means happy to do it; opposite "unwilling".

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot interview 500 warehouse staff, but you can work deeply with two representatives.", từ "representative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot interview 500 warehouse staff, but you can work deeply with two representatives.", what does "representative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representative /ˌreprɪˈzentətɪv/ (danh từ): người đại diện. Động từ "represent"; "sales representative" = nhân viên kinh doanh.
items.explanationEn: representative /ˌreprɪˈzentətɪv/ (noun): a delegate. Verb: "represent"; a "sales representative" sells on a company's behalf.

items.question: Trong câu "A champion takes responsibility for gathering their group's input and brings you the collective voice.", từ "collective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A champion takes responsibility for gathering their group's input and brings you the collective voice.", what does "collective" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: collective /kəˈlektɪv/ (tính từ): chung của tập thể. "Collective voice/decision" = tiếng nói/quyết định chung của nhóm.
items.explanationEn: collective /kəˈlektɪv/ (adjective): shared by a group. "Collective voice/decision" belongs to the group as a whole.

items.question: Trong câu "They become the product's advocate inside their own department at rollout.", từ "advocate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They become the product's advocate inside their own department at rollout.", what does "advocate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: advocate /ˈædvəkət/ (danh từ): người ủng hộ, bênh vực. Danh từ /ˈædvəkət/ = người ủng hộ; động từ /ˈædvəkeɪt/ = ủng hộ. Nghĩa khác: luật sư.
items.explanationEn: advocate /ˈædvəkət/ (noun): a public supporter. The noun /ˈædvəkət/ is a supporter; the verb /ˈædvəkeɪt/ means to support. It can also mean a lawyer.

items.question: Trong câu "They become the product's advocate inside their own department at rollout.", từ "rollout" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They become the product's advocate inside their own department at rollout.", what does "rollout" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rollout /ˈroʊlaʊt/ (danh từ): đợt triển khai. Cụm động từ "roll out" = triển khai dần; trái nghĩa gần "roll back" (hoàn tác).
items.explanationEn: rollout /ˈroʊlaʊt/ (noun): a launch. The phrasal verb is "roll out"; its near-opposite is "roll back".

items.question: Trong câu "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", từ "relay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", what does "relay" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: relay /ˈriːleɪ/ (động từ): truyền đạt lại. "Relay a message" = chuyển lời; "relay race" = chạy tiếp sức.
items.explanationEn: relay /ˈriːleɪ/ (verb): to pass on. "Relay a message" means pass it on; a "relay race" is a team race.

items.question: Trong câu "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", từ "second-hand" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", what does "second-hand" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: second-hand /ˌsekənd ˈhænd/ (tính từ): nghe qua người khác. "Second-hand account" = thông tin nghe lại; "second-hand car" = xe cũ. Trái nghĩa "first-hand".
items.explanationEn: second-hand /ˌsekənd ˈhænd/ (adjective): heard from others. A "second-hand account" is heard from others; a "second-hand car" is used. Opposite: "first-hand".

items.question: Trong câu "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", từ "account" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real user, not a manager relaying second-hand accounts.", what does "account" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: account /əˈkaʊnt/ (danh từ): lời kể, tường thuật. "Account" ở đây là lời kể; nghĩa khác: tài khoản, hoặc "key account" = khách hàng lớn.
items.explanationEn: account /əˈkaʊnt/ (noun): a report of events. Here it is a report of what happened; it also means a login or, as "key account", a major client.

items.question: Trong câu "A common trap: picking the most available person rather than the most knowledgeable.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common trap: picking the most available person rather than the most knowledgeable.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): sai lầm dễ mắc. "Fall into the trap of" = mắc bẫy, mắc sai lầm; nghĩa đen là bẫy bắt thú.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): an easy mistake. "Fall into the trap of" means make that easy mistake; literally a device for catching animals.

items.question: Trong câu "A common trap: picking the most available person rather than the most knowledgeable.", từ "knowledgeable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common trap: picking the most available person rather than the most knowledgeable.", what does "knowledgeable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: knowledgeable /ˈnɑːlɪdʒəbl/ (tính từ): hiểu biết sâu. Gốc "knowledge"; "knowledgeable about something" = am hiểu điều gì.
items.explanationEn: knowledgeable /ˈnɑːlɪdʒəbl/ (adjective): well-informed. From "knowledge"; "knowledgeable about something" means well-informed on it.

items.question: Trong câu "People are often available precisely because they hold no critical role in the process — and the requirements you gather will reflect that.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People are often available precisely because they hold no critical role in the process — and the requirements you gather will reflect that.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): chính là (vì). "Precisely because" = chính vì; tính từ "precise" = chính xác.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): exactly. "Precisely because" means exactly because; adjective: "precise".

items.question: Trong câu "People are often available precisely because they hold no critical role in the process — and the requirements you gather will reflect that.", từ "reflect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People are often available precisely because they hold no critical role in the process — and the requirements you gather will reflect that.", what does "reflect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (động từ): phản ánh. "Reflect something" = phản ánh; "reflect on" = suy ngẫm; nghĩa vật lý là phản chiếu.
items.explanationEn: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (verb): to show the effect of. "Reflect something" means show it; "reflect on" means think about; physically, to throw back light.

items.question: Trong câu "Disagreement between stakeholders is normal and unavoidable, because their goals differ.", từ "unavoidable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disagreement between stakeholders is normal and unavoidable, because their goals differ.", what does "unavoidable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (tính từ): không thể tránh. Tiền tố "un-" + "avoidable"; đồng nghĩa "inevitable".
items.explanationEn: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (adjective): inevitable. "un-" + "avoidable"; a synonym is "inevitable".

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: clarify with concrete examples and visual models.", từ "visual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: clarify with concrete examples and visual models.", what does "visual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: visual /ˈvɪʒuəl/ (tính từ): trực quan, bằng hình. "Visual model" = mô hình trực quan (sơ đồ); đừng nhầm với "virtual" (ảo).
items.explanationEn: visual /ˈvɪʒuəl/ (adjective): using images. A "visual model" is a diagram or picture; do not confuse it with "virtual".

items.question: Trong câu "A great many disagreements evaporate once everyone looks at the same diagram.", từ "evaporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great many disagreements evaporate once everyone looks at the same diagram.", what does "evaporate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evaporate /ɪˈvæpəreɪt/ (động từ): tan biến. Nghĩa đen là bay hơi; nghĩa bóng "disagreements evaporate" = bất đồng tự tan biến.
items.explanationEn: evaporate /ɪˈvæpəreɪt/ (verb): to disappear. Literally water turning to vapour; figuratively, disagreements simply vanish.

items.question: Trong câu "Sales wants feature A, operations wants feature B, and there is only capacity for one.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sales wants feature A, operations wants feature B, and there is only capacity for one.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the work a team can do
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): năng lực làm việc. "Team capacity" = khối lượng việc đội làm được; "in my capacity as" = với tư cách là.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): the work a team can do. "Team capacity" is how much work a team can take on; "in my capacity as" means in my role as.

items.question: Trong câu "Your job is to make the trade-off explicit with data — value, cost, risk of each option — and take it to whoever has the authority.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your job is to make the trade-off explicit with data — value, cost, risk of each option — and take it to whoever has the authority.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɔːf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off" = chấp nhận mất cái này để được cái kia; BA làm rõ sự đánh đổi bằng dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɔːf/ (noun): a balancing compromise. A trade-off gives up one thing to gain another; the BA makes it explicit with data.

items.question: Trong câu "Your job is to make the trade-off explicit with data — value, cost, risk of each option — and take it to whoever has the authority.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your job is to make the trade-off explicit with data — value, cost, risk of each option — and take it to whoever has the authority.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng. Trái nghĩa "implicit" (ngầm); "explicit content" còn nghĩa là nội dung nhạy cảm.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. Opposite of "implicit"; "explicit content" also means offensive material.

items.question: Trong câu "3. Disagreement from conflicting interests.", từ "conflicting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "3. Disagreement from conflicting interests.", what does "conflicting" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conflicting /kənˈflɪktɪŋ/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Conflicting interests/requirements" = lợi ích/yêu cầu mâu thuẫn; danh từ "conflict".
items.explanationEn: conflicting /kənˈflɪktɪŋ/ (adjective): clashing. "Conflicting interests/requirements" clash with each other; noun: "conflict".

items.question: Trong câu "How to handle it: name it honestly but respectfully.", từ "respectfully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to handle it: name it honestly but respectfully.", what does "respectfully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: respectfully /rɪˈspektfəli/ (trạng từ): một cách tôn trọng. Đừng nhầm với "respectively" (lần lượt, tương ứng).
items.explanationEn: respectfully /rɪˈspektfəli/ (adverb): with respect. Do not confuse it with "respectively" (in the order given).

items.question: Trong câu "A key principle: the BA clarifies and supplies data; the person with authority decides.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A key principle: the BA clarifies and supplies data; the person with authority decides.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply data/information" = cung cấp dữ liệu; danh từ "supply" = nguồn cung.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. "Supply data/information" means provide it; the noun means an available stock.

items.question: Trong câu "If you decide for them, you carry responsibility for a decision you had no right to make — and it will be reversed late.", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you decide for them, you carry responsibility for a decision you had no right to make — and it will be reversed late.", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɜːrs/ (động từ): đảo ngược, hủy bỏ. "Reverse a decision" = đảo ngược quyết định; "reverse the car" = lùi xe.
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɜːrs/ (verb): to overturn. "Reverse a decision" means overturn it; "reverse the car" means drive backwards.

items.question: Trong câu "For each stakeholder group: what they need to know, how often, through which channel, at what level of detail.", từ "channel" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each stakeholder group: what they need to know, how often, through which channel, at what level of detail.", what does "channel" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: channel /ˈtʃænl/ (danh từ): kênh liên lạc. "Communication channel" = kênh giao tiếp (email, họp, chat); nghĩa khác: kênh TV, eo biển.
items.explanationEn: channel /ˈtʃænl/ (noun): a means of contact. A "communication channel" is email, meetings or chat; other senses: a TV station, a strait.

items.question: Trong câu "2. Close the loop.", từ "close the loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "2. Close the loop.", what does "close the loop" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: close the loop /kloʊz ðə luːp/ (cụm từ): phản hồi lại kết quả. "Close the loop" = báo lại kết quả cho người đã hỏi, để việc không bị bỏ lửng.
items.explanationEn: close the loop /kloʊz ðə luːp/ (phrase): to report back the result. "Close the loop" means telling the requester what happened so nothing is left hanging.

items.question: Trong câu "When someone raises a request or a concern, always report back the outcome — even when the answer is no.", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When someone raises a request or a concern, always report back the outcome — even when the answer is no.", what does "concern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːrn/ (danh từ): mối lo ngại. "Raise a concern" = nêu mối lo ngại; "a going concern" = doanh nghiệp đang hoạt động.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːrn/ (noun): a worry. "Raise a concern" means voice a worry; "a going concern" is an operating business.

items.question: Trong câu "When someone raises a request or a concern, always report back the outcome — even when the answer is no.", từ "report back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When someone raises a request or a concern, always report back the outcome — even when the answer is no.", what does "report back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: report back /rɪˈpɔːrt bæk/ (cụm từ): báo lại cho biết. "Report back to someone" = báo lại kết quả cho người đã giao/hỏi.
items.explanationEn: report back /rɪˈpɔːrt bæk/ (phrase): to tell the result. "Report back to someone" means telling them the result after looking into it.

items.question: Trong câu "People who never hear back stop contributing and start working around you.", từ "work around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People who never hear back stop contributing and start working around you.", what does "work around" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: work around /wɜːrk əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): lách qua, bỏ qua. "Work around someone" = đi đường vòng, bỏ qua ai; danh từ "workaround".
items.explanationEn: work around /wɜːrk əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to bypass. "Work around someone" means bypass them; noun: "workaround".

items.question: Trong câu "People who never hear back stop contributing and start working around you.", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People who never hear back stop contributing and start working around you.", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/ (động từ): đóng góp. "Contribute to something" = đóng góp vào; danh từ "contribution", "contributor".
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪbjuːt/ (verb): to give input. "Contribute to something" means give to it; nouns: "contribution", "contributor".

items.question: Trong câu "3. Revisit the stakeholder list regularly.", từ "revisit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "3. Revisit the stakeholder list regularly.", what does "revisit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪzɪt/ (động từ): xem xét lại. "Revisit a plan/decision" = xem xét lại; nghĩa đen là quay lại thăm.
items.explanationEn: revisit /ˌriːˈvɪzɪt/ (verb): to review again. "Revisit a plan/decision" means look at it again; literally, go back to a place.

items.question: Trong câu "4. Build credibility before you need it.", từ "credibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "4. Build credibility before you need it.", what does "credibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credibility /ˌkredəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): uy tín, sự tin cậy. Tính từ "credible" = đáng tin; "lose credibility" = mất uy tín.
items.explanationEn: credibility /ˌkredəˈbɪləti/ (noun): trustworthiness. Adjective: "credible"; "lose credibility" means people stop trusting you.

items.question: Trong câu "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ. "Defend a decision" = bảo vệ quyết định; danh từ "defence/defense".
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to argue for. "Defend a decision" means argue for it; noun: "defence/defense".

items.question: Trong câu "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", từ "credit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", what does "credit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credit /ˈkredɪt/ (danh từ): uy tín tích lũy. Ở đây là uy tín, sự tin tưởng; nghĩa khác: tín dụng, tín chỉ, phần ghi công (credits).
items.explanationEn: credit /ˈkredɪt/ (noun): earned trust. Here it means earned trust; other senses: a loan, a course unit, the credits of a film.

items.question: Trong câu "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", từ "hearing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you must say no or defend a hard decision, the credit you accumulated by being right and honest earlier is what earns you a hearing.", what does "hearing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hearing /ˈhɪrɪŋ/ (danh từ): cơ hội được lắng nghe. "Earn/get a hearing" = được người khác chịu lắng nghe; nghĩa khác: thính giác, phiên tòa.
items.explanationEn: hearing /ˈhɪrɪŋ/ (noun): a chance to be heard. "Earn/get a hearing" means people are willing to listen; other senses: the sense of sound, a court session.

items.question: Trong câu "A relationship health indicator: when stakeholders come to you for an opinion before deciding, you have become a partner rather than a note-taker.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A relationship health indicator: when stakeholders come to you for an opinion before deciding, you have become a partner rather than a note-taker.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪndɪkeɪtər/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu, chỉ số. "Key performance indicator" (KPI) = chỉ số hiệu suất; "indicator" còn là đèn xi nhan (Anh).
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪndɪkeɪtər/ (noun): a sign or measure. A KPI is a "key performance indicator"; in British English it is also a car's turn signal.

items.question: Trong câu "A relationship health indicator: when stakeholders come to you for an opinion before deciding, you have become a partner rather than a note-taker.", từ "note-taker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A relationship health indicator: when stakeholders come to you for an opinion before deciding, you have become a partner rather than a note-taker.", what does "note-taker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: note-taker /ˈnoʊt teɪkər/ (danh từ): người chỉ ghi chép. "Note-taker" = người ghi biên bản; BA tốt là đối tác, không chỉ là người ghi chép.
items.explanationEn: note-taker /ˈnoʊt teɪkər/ (noun): a person taking notes. A "note-taker" just records; a good BA becomes a partner instead.

items.question: Trong câu "The four most-missed groups: indirect users, operations and support, compliance functions, external systems and partners.", từ "indirect" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four most-missed groups: indirect users, operations and support, compliance functions, external systems and partners.", what does "indirect" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: indirect /ˌɪndəˈrekt/ (tính từ): gián tiếp. "Indirect users" = người không dùng hệ thống nhưng chịu tác động (nhận báo cáo...).
items.explanationEn: indirect /ˌɪndəˈrekt/ (adjective): not direct. "Indirect users" never use the system but are affected by it, e.g. report recipients.

items.question: Trong câu "The influence-interest matrix allocates communication effort; it is not a ranking of people.", từ "ranking" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The influence-interest matrix allocates communication effort; it is not a ranking of people.", what does "ranking" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ranking /ˈræŋkɪŋ/ (danh từ): bảng xếp hạng. Gốc "rank" = hạng; ma trận không nhằm xếp hạng con người.
items.explanationEn: ranking /ˈræŋkɪŋ/ (noun): an order by rank. From "rank"; the matrix is not meant to rate people.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not confuse title with influence — a long-serving specialist may outweigh a new department head.", từ "outweigh" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not confuse title with influence — a long-serving specialist may outweigh a new department head.", what does "outweigh" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outweigh /ˌaʊtˈweɪ/ (động từ): có sức nặng hơn. "The benefits outweigh the costs" = lợi ích lớn hơn chi phí.
items.explanationEn: outweigh /ˌaʊtˈweɪ/ (verb): to matter more than. "The benefits outweigh the costs" means they matter more.

items.question: Trong câu "Closing the loop is mandatory — people who never hear back stop contributing and work around you.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Closing the loop is mandatory — people who never hear back stop contributing and work around you.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmændətɔːri/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. Đồng nghĩa "compulsory", "required"; trái nghĩa "optional".
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmændətɔːri/ (adjective): required. Synonyms: "compulsory", "required"; opposite: "optional".

items.question: Trong câu "Map by influence and interest to spend effort where it counts, and update as positions change.", từ "where it counts" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map by influence and interest to spend effort where it counts, and update as positions change.", what does "where it counts" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: where it counts /wer ɪt kaʊnts/ (cụm từ): chỗ quan trọng. "Count" ở đây nghĩa là có giá trị, quan trọng; "every vote counts" = mỗi phiếu đều quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: where it counts /wer ɪt kaʊnts/ (phrase): where it matters. "Count" here means matter; "every vote counts" means each vote is important.

items.question: Trong câu "When disagreement arises, the BA's role is to make the trade-off explicit with data, while the decision belongs to whoever has authority.", từ "arise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When disagreement arises, the BA's role is to make the trade-off explicit with data, while the decision belongs to whoever has authority.", what does "arise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arise /əˈraɪz/ (động từ): phát sinh. "Problems/questions arise" = vấn đề phát sinh; quá khứ "arose", phân từ "arisen".
items.explanationEn: arise /əˈraɪz/ (verb): to come up. "Problems/questions arise" means they come up; past "arose", participle "arisen".
